## Subtask C — Architecture/Structural Claims vs. Actual src/ Code

| Claimed Structure | Doc Location | Actual src/ State | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| "Orchestration & configuration layer — CLI + YAML config" | README.md Mermaid diagram (ORCH box) | No YAML anywhere: grep -rli yaml src/ → zero hits; no pyyaml/ruamel in pyproject.toml or uv.lock; no *config*.py files. cli.py is pure argparse — all params are CLI flags with hardcoded defaults | OVERSTATED |
| Same "CLI + YAML config" orchestration box | report/src/images/architecture_highlevel.jpg [IMAGE] | Same as above — image depicts a YAML config layer with no code counterpart. Image also shows UTKFace as a live 20,000+ image intake path flowing straight into ingestion, undifferentiated from FairFace — unlike README's Mermaid diagram, which marks UTKFace/CUT with dashed styling reflecting the actual Cut-List #2 decision | OVERSTATED (YAML) + STALE (UTKFace cut not reflected) |
| FR-008: layer "exposes a configuration file and command-line interface" | systemArchitectureAndMethodology.tex §"Orchestration and Configuration Layer" | No config-file loading mechanism exists in src/ (see above); CrossValidationOrchestrator tolerances (tolerance_difference=0.05, tolerance_ratio=0.10) are hardcoded Python constructor defaults, not externally configurable, and cli.py instantiates it with zero args | OVERSTATED |
| Facade pattern: class AuditOrchestrator (Design patterns table, "Orchestration" row) | same .tex, sec:patterns table | No class named AuditOrchestrator anywhere in src/. The only orchestrator class is CrossValidationOrchestrator, defined at fairness/backends.py:965 — inside the fairness subpackage, not a standalone top-level orchestration module | STALE (name + location both wrong) |
| Adapter pattern: ModelInterface → DirectInferenceAdapter / PredictionsFileAdapter | same .tex table | Actual: ModelInterface(ABC) (model_interface.py:44) → InProcessInterface (:53), PredictionsFileInterface (:83). Neither claimed subclass name exists | STALE |
| Builder pattern: TestMatrixBuilder (Data Ingestion) | same .tex table | No such class in data_ingestion.py. Actual top-level class: DataIngestionPipeline, plus OvRTransformer, IngestionConfig, IngestionResult | STALE |
| Factory pattern: ReportFactory → HTMLReportBuilder (Report Generation) | same .tex table | Actual class: HTMLReportGenerator (report/generator.py:54, re-exported via report/__init__.py). No ReportFactory or HTMLReportBuilder exists | STALE |
| Template Method: AuditReport base class (Report Generation) | same .tex table | No class of this name anywhere in src/ (full grep -rn "^class " src/bias_aperture/ shows no match) | STALE |
| Strategy pattern: FairnessBackend → AIF360Backend / FairlearnBackend | same .tex table | Matches exactly: fairness/base.py:205 class FairnessBackend(abc.ABC); fairness/backends.py:46 class FairlearnBackend, :457 class AIF360Backend | MATCHES |
| Module table: Data Ingestion, Model Interface, Fairness Metrics Engine, Explainability Layer, Report Generation, "Orchestration and Configuration" (6 rows) | .tex §system architecture, opening table | First 5 rows map 1:1 to real files (data_ingestion.py, model_interface.py, fairness/, explainability.py, report/). 6th row ("Orchestration and Configuration") has no dedicated module — it's cli.py acting as the entry point, conflated in the doc with the fictitious config-file claim above | OVERSTATED (6th row only; first 5 MATCH) |
| Pipeline: PredictionsFileInterface → SubjectRecord → CLI / audit orchestration → fairness backend(s) → explainability → Jinja2 report | specs/01-architecture.md | Matches cli.py main() exactly; component table (model_interface.py, data_ingestion.py, fairness/, fairness/statistics.py, explainability.py, report/, cli.py) matches actual filenames 1:1; no YAML/config claim made | MATCHES |
| 9-step run flow (parse args → ingest → validate → select axis → run backends → stats → explainability → render HTML → non-zero on failure) | specs/03-orchestrator.md | Matches actual cli.py main() control flow step-for-step; no config-file step asserted | MATCHES |
| Topology diagram: CrossValidationOrchestrator (WP4) ◄ Shared Pre-Filter n>=30, → FairlearnBackend / AIF360Backend | docs/research/MID_LEVEL_ARCHITECTURE.md | Matches exactly — correct class names, correct subpackage location (fairness/) | MATCHES |
| WP5 "High-level facade orchestrating the pipeline" (functional description, no class name asserted) + explicit real class names (FairlearnBackend, AIF360Backend, CrossValidationOrchestrator) elsewhere in doc | docs/research/HIGH_LEVEL_SYNTHESIS.md | cli.py does functionally serve as that facade; no fictitious class name claimed, unlike the .tex chapter | MATCHES |

### Answers to the 3 specific verification questions

1. YAML config loader exists? No — confirmed via grep -rli yaml src/ (0 hits), pyproject.toml/uv.lock (no yaml dependency), and full cli.py read (pure argparse, no file-based config path).
2. Literal "orchestration layer" class/module, or just CrossValidationOrchestrator inside fairness/backends.py? The latter — no standalone orchestration module exists; CrossValidationOrchestrator lives inside the fairness subpackage, and cli.py itself performs the sequencing/facade role.
3. Do diagram/doc module names match actual file/class names? Partially. README, architecture_highlevel.jpg, specs/, and docs/research/*.md box-level module names match src/ 1:1. The .tex chapter's Design Patterns table (sec:patterns) is the outlier — 4 of its 6 named classes (AuditOrchestrator, DirectInferenceAdapter/PredictionsFileAdapter, TestMatrixBuilder, ReportFactory/HTMLReportBuilder, AuditReport) do not exist under any name in src/.

### Bonus finding (out of requested scope, flagged for owner awareness)

src/bias_aperture/report/generator.py and src/bias_aperture/report/templates/generator.py are near-duplicate files (byte-identical except trailing newline) defining the same ReportContext/HTMLReportGenerator classes twice. Only report/generator.py is wired up via report/__init__.py; the templates/ copy appears to be dead/orphaned code. Not claimed by any doc reviewed in this subtask, so not scored in the table above, but directly relevant to "actual src/ state."

### Method notes
Cloned https://github.com/Aaradhya-Dev-Tamrakar/BiasAperture.git (main, shallow) read-only to /home/claude/BiasAperture. No files edited, no commits, no sync.ps1 invocation. All findings sourced from live grep/cat/ls/view against the cloned tree, not from memory or prior-session assumptions.
summary: Verified README Mermaid diagram, architecture_highlevel.jpg, systemArchitectureAndMethodology.tex, MID/HIGH_LEVEL_ARCHITECTURE.md, and specs/01+03 against actual src/bias_aperture/ (full class grep + cli.py read). Confirmed: no YAML config loader exists anywhere (OVERSTATED in README diagram, image, and .tex FR-008); no standalone orchestration class/module beyond CrossValidationOrchestrator inside fairness/backends.py. specs/, README structure list, and docs/research/*.md all match actual code 1:1. The .tex chapter's Design Patterns table (sec:patterns) is the main offender — 5 of 6 named classes (AuditOrchestrator, DirectInferenceAdapter/PredictionsFileAdapter, TestMatrixBuilder, ReportFactory/HTMLReportBuilder, AuditReport) don't exist under any name in src/; only FairnessBackend→AIF360Backend/FairlearnBackend matches. Flagged a bonus find: duplicate report/generator.py vs report/templates/generator.py (dead code, not doc-claimed). Read-only — no files modified, no sync.ps1 run.
